headline: MCA Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 reported as limited-time clean-up window
summary_points: Legal 500 reports on the Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026, described as a limited-time opportunity for companies.
The scheme is reported to let companies clean up their compliance records; the full text was not available.
Details such as fee relief, eligible filings, start and end dates and the scheme's notification or circular number are not confirmed in the material.
Companies should read the official MCA circular before relying on this report.
who_is_affected: Companies with pending or delayed ROC filings and other compliance defaults under the Companies Act, 2013, and the professionals advising them.
action_required: Check the official MCA notification or circular on the MCA portal for eligibility, fees and deadlines, and plan regularisation of pending filings.

social.linkedin:
MCA's Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 has been reported as a limited-time opportunity for companies to clean up their compliance records.

According to a Legal 500 report, the scheme is aimed at helping companies regularise past compliance gaps. The material available to us does not confirm the scheme's start and end dates, fee relief, eligible forms or notification number.

Why it matters:
- Companies with delayed ROC filings may get a structured route to regularise them.
- A limited window means advance planning is essential.
- Professionals should map clients' pending filings and defaults now.

What to do:
- Review the pending filing status of your clients or your company.
- Track the official MCA circular for scheme terms.
- Prepare data and documents so you can act once the window is open.

This is based on a news report. Please verify all details with the official MCA source before acting.
